rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LEGAL RESEARCH UNIT IN EACH OF THE FIVE (5) DIVISIONS OF THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 213 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Proposes the following --- "A LEGAL RESEARCH UNIT SHALL BE ESTABLISHED IN EACH OF THE FIVE (5) DIVISIONS OF THE COMMISSION TO PROVIDE LEGAL RESEARCH SERVICE IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THEIR ADJUDICATORY FUNCTIONS. THE LEGAL RESEARCHH UNIT SHALL BE COMPOSED OF COMMISSION ATTORNEYS WHO ARE WELL VERSED IN LABOR LAWS, RULES AND REGULATIONS AND JURISPRUDENCE. THEY SHALL RECEIVE ANNUAL SALARIES AND BE ENTITLED TO THE SAME ALLOWANCES, AND BENEFITS AS THOSE EMPLOYEES FALLING  UNDER SALARY GRADE 25.  THERE SHALL BE AS MANY COMMISSION ATTORNEYS AS MAY BE NECESSARY FOR THE EFFECTIVE AND EFFICIENT OPERATION OF THE OCMMISSION BUT IN NO CASE LESS THAN TWO (2) PER COMMISSIONER."

rows.abstract: "Revised Chemical Engineering Law" Advances the following --- "Republic Act No. 318, otherwise known as the Chemical Engineering Law was enacted on June 19 1948. The present advances in technology practically make al phases of negineering work fullyautomated. The availability of advanced, sophisticated and modern instruments has rendered RA No. 318 obsolete, sometimes irrelevant and impractical. A review of the law would reveal that some provisions thereof are inapplicable and therefore proneto be violated than followed.
